title: [slider/priceRange]: Allow changing the values using text inputs
body:
Would be great to have an option that enables the display of two inputs above / under the slider and that enable the user to manually set the wanted values.

I can see various reasons why I can be useful:

* In the case there are a lot of possible values, it might be tricky to set the slider to the exact value.
* On mobile, because screens are smaller, but also touch interactions not as precise as mouse, its often easier to set a value using the keyboard.

What do you think do?
